messages:
sam_partnerships: Quick sync  Nebula Systems signed on for a co-hosted "Marketplace Launch + Hands-on Lab" on Jun 14. Need speakers, lab access, marketplace timing, and swag (power banks).
jordan_hw: We'll demo low-power inferencing on Nebula nodes. Partner demo runs on their rack; Redwood must provide a Private fallback.
tamara_pm: Agreed. Partner runs on-site; Redwood provides sandboxed lab for attendees and lead capture.
liang_eng: I can provision a dedicated lab cluster with preloaded quantized model and ephemeral keys (TTL=8h). Need SSO/allowlist from Nebula.
mel_ops: Shipping plan: Redwood ships 250 power banks to Nebula HQ and 50 to SF. Need customs docs for EU shipments.
sophia_marketing: Need Nebula logo lockups and co-branded LP + UTM. Who provides promo code?
dmitri_nebula: I'll send SVG logos by Tue and Nebula will provide promo NEBULA20 for extended trial credits.
sam_partnerships: Speaker roster proposal: Tamara (Redwood PM), Dmitri (Nebula lead), Jordan (hw demo), Priya (customer cameo). @dmitri_nebula confirm Priya.
dmitri_nebula: Priya confirmed for cameo.
liang_eng: Lab access example (ephemeral): export LAB_KEY=lab_abc123; curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $LAB_KEY" https://lab.redwood-inference.com/run -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'. Health endpoint: /_status -> OK.
jordan_hw: Failover plan: studio -> Nebula rack -> Redwood Private fallback based on /_status. Canary headers: X-Partner: nebula.
calendar-bot: Rehearsal created  Jun 10 08:00 PDT, 120m. Invitees: sam_partnerships, jordan_hw, tamara_pm, liang_eng, dmitri_nebula, priya_customer.
sam_partnerships: Action items: 1) Decks by Jun 1, 2) Lab keys + healthcheck by May 25, 3) Swag addresses by May 10, 4) Logos by Apr 30, 5) Marketplace go-live confirmation by May 12. cc logistics@redwood on shipping. Thanks :rocket:
